svg.title: AWS-only GenAI stack compared with AWS plus Kong
svg.desc: Left: three apps or agents each integrate separately with Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore and MCP tools, each handling its own auth, limits and logging. Right: the same apps call one Kong AI Gateway data plane on Amazon EKS behind a Network Load Balancer with an ACM certificate; Kong applies shared policy and calls the same AWS services using an IAM role via EKS Pod Identity; Kong Konnect, outside AWS, manages Kong configuration and receives telemetry.
svg.text: Same AWS services, two ways to connect to them
Each app or agent handles its own credentials for every service and provider,
rate limits and budgets, logging and tracing, and its own SDK for every model provider.
Fine for one team and one provider. Harder to govern as more teams and agents arrive.
Apps keep calling one endpoint. Policy lives in one place. AWS services are unchanged.
